blocks.title: Solar PV systems for homes and businesses
blocks.body:
JFL Solar provides solar PV installation, consultancy and equipment distribution in the Philippines. We work with homeowners who want lower electricity bills and backup power, with commercial and industrial clients planning larger systems, and with DIY buyers and professional installers who need dependable equipment.

Our aim is simple: reliable, efficient solar energy solutions, supported properly before and after handover.
blocks.review_note: Describes the confirmed business scope. Edit freely.

blocks.title: Our story
blocks.body: JFL Solar was founded in June 2024 as a new, dynamic company with one focus: bringing top-quality solar PV equipment and services to the Philippines, and helping homes and businesses make the switch to reliable, efficient solar energy.
blocks.review_note: Founding date (June 2024) is from the About Us sheet. Confirm before production.

blocks.title: Our mission
blocks.body: To be the leading provider of high-quality solar PV equipment and installation services in the Philippines, delivering exceptional value and unparalleled after-sales service and technical support through innovation, expertise, and a commitment to sustainability.
blocks.review_note: Owner-supplied mission statement (About Us sheet), punctuation tidied. Please approve the wording.

blocks.title: Our vision
blocks.body: To see solar PV systems on the roofs of homes and business establishments across the Philippines, driving the nation towards a sustainable, energy-independent and greener future.
blocks.review_note: Owner-supplied vision statement (About Us sheet), lightly edited for readability. Please approve.

blocks.title: JF Legaspi
blocks.subtitle: Founder and CEO
blocks.body: A leader with extensive experience in the European solar industry, JF Legaspi founded JFL Solar to share his technical expertise with his fellow Filipinos and to advance renewable energy solutions in the Philippines.
blocks.review_note: Founder name, title and 'extensive experience in the European solar industry' are from the flyers. Confirm wording, credentials and whether a photo may be published.

blocks.title: Tier-1 quality focus
blocks.subtitle: Quality assurance
blocks.body: Every component and solar technology we supply goes through testing and quality assurance before it is deployed.
blocks.review_note: Flyer says 'Tier-1 quality guaranteed'. 'Guaranteed' removed. Confirm what 'Tier-1' refers to (e.g. a published manufacturer list) and what testing is actually performed.

blocks.title: Priority warranty assistance
blocks.subtitle: Warranty assistance
blocks.body: To prevent system downtime, we provide immediate replacement or loaner units for inverters, batteries and solar panels during warranty claims.
blocks.review_note: Replacement/loaner-unit promise from the 'Why choose us' flyer. Confirm the policy, conditions and coverage before production — do not publish without approval.

blocks.title: Dedicated technical support
blocks.subtitle: Technical support
blocks.body: We build long-term partnerships with our clients through dedicated post-installation support and expert maintenance. Clients who purchase their supplies from us receive free technical support, from commissioning and parameter settings to troubleshooting. Sagot ka namin.
blocks.review_note: Free technical-support offer and 'Sagot ka namin!' are from the supplier and package flyers. Confirm scope (who qualifies, for how long, channels).

blocks.title: After-sales service
blocks.subtitle: After-sales
blocks.body: Our work continues after handover. After-sales service and technical support are central to how we work, for installation clients and equipment buyers alike.
blocks.review_note: Based on the mission statement's after-sales commitment. Confirm what after-sales service includes.
